metadata.title: My School ITALY — Centre-by-Centre Micro-Location SEO Map
metadata.seo_note: Use surrounding neighbourhood names naturally inside each centre page, as Footprints does. Do not stuff every locality into one paragraph. Mention only places genuinely served by the centre; verify travel relevance before publishing.
metadata.distance_drive_time_note: Planning estimates for parent convenience. Road distance and drive time vary by exact starting point, route, school-hour traffic, roadworks and weather. Before publishing a precise number on the website, the local centre team should verify the route in Google Maps from a representative landmark in each micro-location.

usage_guidelines.title: How to Use Micro-Locations Without Keyword Stuffing
usage_guidelines.objective: The objective is local relevance, not repetition. Google-facing pages should still read beautifully for parents.

rules.instruction: Use 4–7 genuinely nearby micro-locations once in a natural sentence.
rules.example: Our Kondapur centre on Botanical Garden Road is convenient for families from NCB Enclave, Kothaguda, Whitefields and Masjid Banda.

rules.instruction: Add a small 'Areas We Serve' or 'Convenient for Families From' section with 5–8 neighbourhoods.
rules.example: Kondapur • Kothaguda • Whitefields • Masjid Banda • NCB Enclave • New Hafeezpet

rules.instruction: Use 2–3 locality questions where they are genuinely useful.
rules.example: Is MSI Kondapur convenient from Whitefields? / Do you offer daycare near Kothaguda?

rules.instruction: Mention real roads, junctions and landmarks, not only locality names.
rules.example: Located on Botanical Garden Road near the Kondapur–Kothaguda corridor.

rules.instruction: Link locality terms to the correct centre page only.
rules.example: 'daycare near HITEX' → HITEX centre page, not the generic Hyderabad page.

rules.instruction: Do not create a separate thin page for every micro-locality unless MSI has a real centre or genuinely distinct content there.
rules.example: Do not create 20 nearly identical pages called Preschool Hafeezpet, Preschool Kothaguda, etc.

rules.instruction: Keep centre name, address, phone, hours and landing-page URL consistent with the website.
rules.example: Each eligible centre should link to its own location page.

rules.instruction: Local teams should check the final micro-location list for actual parent catchment and practical drive routes.
rules.example: Especially important for Tadepalligudem and additional Berhampur listings.

website_style_guidelines.instruction: Prefer “approximately 3–5 km / 10–18 minutes” over “4.2 km / 13 minutes” unless the route has been checked from a fixed landmark.
For Hyderabad and Pune especially, use “typically” or “approximately” and add “depending on traffic.”
Very Close and Close areas can appear in the main centre page. Wider Catchment areas are better in an FAQ or ‘Areas We Serve’ section.
Centre managers should check representative Google Maps routes during school-run hours and update the range if needed.
